visualCharacteristics.purpose: Compact header utility actions such as a "How can we help?" search entry and "Sign On"

contentPattern.structure: utility links (optionally with a leading :icon:) as a list, one per paragraph, one per cell or one per row; all are flattened into a single divided row

usage: Header component: utility actions row (search entry, sign on). Standalone block; the site header is migrated separately.
reuseGuidance: Use for 1-4 short utility links/actions. Use primary-nav for main section navigation.
